business_problem: The 49ers' templated mobile app limited personalization and fan engagement outside the football season. The franchise wanted an adaptable digital experience that could strengthen year-round fan relationships and create new business opportunities.
solution_summary: PwC and the 49ers built an AI-native fan platform that combines application engineering, data architecture, privacy, and experience design. Anthropic-powered AI tools helped the engineering team analyze fan input, shape requirements, generate screens, and automate testing, with PwC engineers validating the outputs. In the live experience, AI personalizes content based on fan preferences and behavior, while the app brings together community groups, a season-ticket member hub, ticket access, and sponsorship inventory. More than 2,000 fans were surveyed to prioritize 150 features. The platform launched in six months and is managed as an evolving digital business, with real-time operations supporting issue detection and faster releases. The source does not specify the underlying AI products, data stores, or model architecture.

data_flow: Fan survey input and ongoing preferences and behavior inform platform features and personalized content; the app serves tailored experiences and engagement opportunities to fans, while operational monitoring supports updates and improvements.
business_outcome: Average dwell time grew from 30 seconds to more than 10 minutes, offseason daily active users increased 150%, and the platform reached users in more than 134 countries. PwC delivered the platform in six months.
